gm_text: Rain spatters against the soot-dark stone of Cinderwatch's eastern gate, where frayed banners shudder in the chilly wind. The muddy approach to the gate is congested with foot traffic, refugees, and wagons, all pressing forward under the watchful eyes of guards who hold the choke point firm. Nearby, a tavern runner calls out energetically, hawking hot stew and tidbits of rumor to the waiting crowd. A notice board catches your eye; it prominently displays new taxes and curfew rules alongside a troubling warning about a missing patrol. Among the crowd, a lone figure dressed in threadbare clothes remains unnervingly still, their gaze darting more toward the passing faces and packs than the gate itself.
